character_facts: The people shown are being displaced or evacuated rather than living normally.
The crowd maintains order and near-silence during the departure.
At least some individuals are involved in honoring or burying their dead during the evacuation.
characters_present: Large crowds of colonists or residents
Armored personnel involved in burial and evacuation
continuity_links: This page depicts consequences on Philoendra and a transition from habitation to evacuation.
The exodus and burial imagery suggest continuation of a larger conflict, collapse, or colonization process already underway.
dialogue_meaning: Narration explains a burial custom tied to exile from an alien world: a small amount of Philoendra's soil will remain with the dead.
Narration emphasizes that the exodus happens in shocked, disciplined silence.
Narration states that after the population leaves, industrial exploitation will turn Philoendra's surface into wasteland.
locations: Snow-covered alien settlement or industrial zone on Philoendra
Mass embarkation/exodus site with huge structures and transport craft
lore_facts: The world shown is named Philoendra.
People associated with Philoendra are living on an alien land.
There is a funerary practice of burying the dead with some soil from Philoendra.
A large-scale, organized planetary exodus takes place from this location.
After the exodus, industrial activity is expected to devastate Philoendra's surface.
The narration names 'Troglosocialiks' as a group driven away or displaced by the massive operation.
plot_events: A bundled armored figure walks through a devastated, snow-covered area filled with crowds and debris.
A burial or memorial act is performed for the dead of an alien land.
Narration states that a little of Philoendra's earth will accompany the departing people when they are buried there.
A planetary exodus begins in silent, orderly fashion.
Large numbers of people assemble and move through an industrial embarkation zone with vehicles and supplies.
Ships depart overhead as the evacuation proceeds.
Narration says the departure leaves Philoendra to be transformed into wasteland by industrial forces.
uncertainties: Some narration is difficult to read precisely; terms such as 'Troglosocialiks' and the exact wording about industrial predators may be imperfectly transcribed.
The specific identities, ranks, and affiliations of the armored figures are not given on this page alone.
It is unclear whether the small object being held in the mid-page panel is remains, soil, or another burial-related item.
visual_summary: In a snowy industrial landscape, armored workers or soldiers move through crowds, carry out burials, and prepare a mass departure. Small top panels show a figure walking past wreckage and crowds, kneeling over a body or grave marker, and carrying belongings. A larger panel shows one helmeted figure presenting a small object or remains to another amid a packed group. The main lower panel depicts immense structures, heavy vehicles, and long lines of people and cargo moving toward embarkation while ships lift off overhead.
